list: The official 55 trophies, as published for PlayStation 5 (list as of 2026-11-18)
note: Names, descriptions and grades below are the official ones. Every guide is written for this entry in its own words. GTA VI is not out yet and no public walkthrough exists, so where a step cannot be verified before launch the guide says so instead of inventing a location.

trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops the moment you earn the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then the side strands, then activities and collectibles, then the cleanup trophies — and it will unlock on its own. Keep this checklist open as you play so you can see at a glance which trophies are still standing between you and the platinum.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for every other trophy, and none of the other 54 is locked behind a one-time story choice, so this unlocks whenever the last one does.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end and this trophy unlocks. It is the first story beat of the game, so you will earn it naturally in your first session. If you are replaying, the mission is available from the story replay menu — the exact menu layout is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the opening mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. There is no side requirement: just keep playing the story in order. The chapter's mission count and names are not published yet, so the exact length of the chapter is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for Chapter 1 to be finished, and chapters are completed by playing the story through, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Keep following the story missions in order and it will come on its own. Which missions belong to Chapter 2 is not published yet, so the chapter's exact contents are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for Chapter 2 to be finished, and chapters are completed by playing the story through, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. By this point you will be deep into Vice City itself, so the story missions are the main thread to follow. The chapter's mission list is not published yet, so its exact contents are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for Chapter 3 to be finished, and chapters are completed by playing the story through, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it marks the endgame of the story. The chapter's mission list is not published yet, so its exact contents are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for Chapter 4 to be finished, and chapters are completed by playing the story through, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the story to its end and complete the final mission; this gold trophy unlocks with the credits. It is the story's finish line, so there is no extra requirement beyond reaching it. The final mission's name is not published yet, so its exact identity is to be confirmed at launch — do not trust any leaked name until the game is out.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks for the final mission to be completed, and the final mission is always available at the end of the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run from start to finish. The title suggests a run of some kind early in the story, but the mission's place in the chapters and its objectives are not published yet — the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch. If you miss it on a first pass, replay it from the story replay menu.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, which the name marks as a heist against a cartel. Heists in this series usually have a setup phase before the main job, so expect preparatory missions to appear first — the exact setup steps are to be confirmed at launch. Finish the heist itself and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play from start to finish. The name hints at a family thread, but the mission's objectives and its place in the story are not published yet — the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch. Replay it from the story replay menu if you ever need to.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners from start to finish. The name suggests a headline-making job, but the mission's objectives and its place in the story are not published yet — the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch. Story missions can be replayed, so you can always come back to it.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The name points to a takedown at the airport, but the mission's objectives and its place in the story are not published yet — the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory from start to finish. The operation-style name suggests a large set-piece mission, but its objectives and its place in the story are not published yet — the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch. Replay it from the story replay menu if needed.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a single story mission, and story missions can be replayed, so it cannot be skipped past.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen — this is the game's biggest single grind and the second gold trophy. In this series 100% means the story plus the side strands, activities, collectibles and hidden packages of the checklist; the exact checklist for GTA VI is not published yet, so the full requirements are to be confirmed at launch. Leave this to last: every other trophy on this list feeds into it, and the platinum follows right behind it.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 100% completion, which is earned by finishing everything the game counts, so it is a matter of time, not a one-time moment.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like all count toward the total. The counter is cumulative, so it builds up naturally as you drive and ride around the map; you can also farm it by repeating jumps you like. The exact list of what counts as a stunt is not published yet, so the most reliable moves are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a cumulative count of 250, and stunts can be done anywhere at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers, one of each. The starter list counts 9 activity types, but the official description does not name them, so the exact list is to be confirmed at launch — check the in-game activities menu and tick each one off here as you try it. This is an early-game trophy: work through the activities as you meet them rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks to try each activity type once, and activities stay available through the whole game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. That is a lot of range time, so treat it as a long side project: learn each challenge's scoring, practise the weak ones, and gold them one at a time. The range's location and the challenge list are not published yet — the exact details are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for gold in all 42 challenges, and the range stays open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are a skill activity, so expect to lose a few while you learn each course's line; the win is what counts, not the time. The 14 locations are not published yet — the exact course list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a win at each of 14 locations, and the races stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different matters, so winning the same race twenty times will not do it. Work through the race types the game offers (street, off-road, boat and air races are the series' usual set) and tick each new win off here. The exact race list is not published yet, so the full set is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 20 different race wins, and races stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests, so you will need a decent catch against Cal's score — practise the fishing minigame first on your own, then take the challenge. Where and when Cal's challenge appears is not published yet, so the exact trigger is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a fishing challenge against Cal, and challenges of this kind stay available once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end — any arcade cabinet counts, so pick the shortest or easiest game you find first. Arcade games in this series are usually short score chases, so a single completed run is all it takes. Which cabinets exist and where they are is not published yet, so the exact list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description only asks to complete one arcade game, and arcades stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete it. Side strands usually unlock as the story progresses, so check your contacts and map for Andy's missions as you play and do them as they appear. The strand's mission count and where Andy first appears are not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the final mission of a side strand, and side strands stay open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand until its final mission, then complete it. Do Kenton's missions as they appear on the map so the strand does not sit unfinished into the endgame. The strand's mission count and where Kenton first appears are not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the final mission of a side strand, and side strands stay open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete it. Billy's strand is one of several character strands, so keep an eye on the map for his missions between story beats. The strand's mission count and where Billy first appears are not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the final mission of a side strand, and side strands stay open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands scattered across Leonida — these are the series' classic Strangers & Freaks encounters, each a short chain of its own. Explore the map, follow the stranger markers, and finish each strand to the end; eight completed strands earns the silver. The strangers' identities and locations are not published yet, so the exact list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 8 stranger strands, and stranger encounters stay on the map once found, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand until its final mission, then complete it. Randy's strand ties into the supply side of the story, judging by the trophy name, so expect missions about moving goods. The strand's mission count and where Randy first appears are not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the final mission of a side strand, and side strands stay open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand until its final mission, then complete it. Do Tyrone's missions as they appear so the strand is done before the endgame cleanup. The strand's mission count and where Tyrone first appears are not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names the final mission of a side strand, and side strands stay open once unlocked, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. These are quiet, scenic spots — expect them on beaches, hilltops and viewpoints — and each one you meditate at counts toward the total. The 18 spots are not published yet, so the exact locations are to be confirmed at launch; use this guide's checklist to tick each one off as you find it.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for all 18 spots, and meditation spots are open-world locations that stay available, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and bring the hunt to a successful end. Unique-animal hunts usually mean tracking one specific creature, so follow Bret's instructions and the trail clues rather than hunting at random. Which animal it is and where it roams is not published yet, so the exact details are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description names a hunt for Bret, and the hunt stays available once Bret offers it, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered around Leonida, so this is a slow-burn hunt: pick up every card you pass, and trade or track down the ones you are missing. How many cards and sets exist in total is not published yet, so the full card list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 3 completed card sets, and cards stay in the world to be collected at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida — the name suggests a photo or check-in style action at landmarks. This is a big count, so do it as you travel: whenever you reach a new area, WAiNK It there before you move on. What WAiNK It actually does and which spots count are not published yet, so the exact mechanic is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 100 locations, and locations across Leonida stay visitable all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — the game's challenge list covers driving, shooting, exploration and more, and any 50 count toward the total. Work through the easiest ones first and let the harder ones build up as you play. The full challenge list is not published yet, so the exact roster is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a cumulative count of 50, and challenges stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you when you lose the heat, so plan the escape route first — open roads and water help — and only break line of sight once you are ready to run. Where to reliably earn 4 stars with your partner is not published yet, so the best spot is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a 4-star escape with your partner, and wanted levels can be raised again at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — the trick is the back-to-back part, so plan a route between three nearby shops and move fast between them. Do not lose the cops in between, or the chain breaks. Which shops count and the best route are not published yet, so the exact plan is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 3 shop robberies in a row with your partner, and shops can be robbed again at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — driving or riding in a new model counts it as discovered, so variety is the goal, not mileage. Try everything you pass: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the count. The full vehicle roster is not published yet, so the complete list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 100 vehicles discovered, and vehicles stay available across Leonida all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends — a single use, so all five must fall in one activation. Pick a busy fight with clustered enemies, line up the shots, and do not waste the window on cover. How Combat Focus is triggered and how long it lasts are not published yet, so the exact mechanic is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus use, and fights can be started again at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the description's joke is that you are not taking a booked flight. Expect this to mean stealing a plane or otherwise departing the airport without going through the terminal. The exact trigger is not published yet, so the precise method is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA, and the airport stays open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tank — in whatever way the game counts. The jokey description does not spell out the requirement, so the honest reading is that it involves the Rhino tank somehow, most likely driving or using one. The exact trigger is not published yet and the description gives no number or action, so the precise requirement is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description gives no one-time condition, and anything involving a tank can be repeated, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected — stealth is the whole requirement, so plan the approach, keep quiet, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails and you will need to try again. Which jewelry stores exist and their layouts are not published yet, so the exact plan is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for one undetected jewelry robbery, and jewelry stores can be robbed again at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — five successful vault jobs earns the silver. Bank vaults are the big robberies, so expect planning, heavy police response and a getaway to survive. Where the vaults are and how each job opens is not published yet, so the exact details are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 5 vault robberies with escapes, and banks stay open to robbery all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — one clean truck job is all it takes. Armored trucks patrol the roads, so watch for one, hit it, and get away before the police close in. The trucks' routes and the best way to crack one open are not published yet, so the exact method is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for one armored truck robbery and escape, and trucks keep patrolling all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida — the starter list counts 52 areas, and the trophy pops when the map is fully revealed. Drive the roads, visit the towns and the wilderness, and let the map fill in as you go; this pairs naturally with the collectible hunts. The exact area list is not published yet, so the full map is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks to explore all of Leonida, and every area stays visitable all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations somewhere in Leonida, so this is a tour of the underworld — find one operation per gang, hit it, and move on to the next. The gangs and their operations are not published yet, so the exact list is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for one operation per gang, and gang operations stay available all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach — the beachfront bars are the obvious place to look. This is a small flavour trophy, the kind you earn by stopping to enjoy the setting, so do it whenever you are passing the beach. The exact bar or spot is not published yet, so the precise location is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and the beach stays open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Rockstar Games — GTA VI official site / trailer

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive through the glass and out the front, the way the series' trailers have always shown it. Pick a showroom, get a fast car inside, and go through the window. Which showrooms allow this is not published yet, so the exact spot is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks to smash out of a showroom, and showrooms stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — the description's joke is a bowling one, so play a frame there and the trophy should pop. Bowling is a casual activity, so fit it in between story missions. The alley's location is not published yet, so the exact spot is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a bowling follow-through at a named alley, and the alley stays open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and it most likely ties to doing things with your partner that the public notices. The exact trigger is not published yet and the description gives no number or action, so the precise requirement is to be confirmed at launch; try partner activities and public moments first.
trophies.missable_reason: The description gives no one-time condition, and partner activities can be repeated, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — the description is deliberately vague, and it most likely tracks decisions you make in the story or with your partner. This one is flagged as possibly missable because a choice, once made, may not come around again in the same playthrough. Play naturally and do not rush past decision moments; if a choice is offered, think before you pick, and the exact trigger is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description says 'Choices made (for better or worse)', and a story choice is only offered once, so a missed choice may need a new playthrough or a replay of that mission.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description suggests something you fail once and then get right the second time. This is flagged as possibly missable because it may be tied to one specific scripted moment rather than any retry anywhere. If a mission or event gives you a second attempt, take it seriously; the exact trigger is not published yet, so it is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description says 'Second time's the charm', and a second attempt may only be offered at one scripted moment, so missing that moment may need a replay.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like a random or hidden event that surprises you. This is flagged as possibly missable because a one-off strange event may only trigger once or in one place. Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring Leonida, especially at night or off the beaten path; the exact event is not published yet, so it is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description says 'What the hell just happened?', and a strange event may only happen once, so it could pass you by without a replay.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl them over. This is a stunt-style combat trophy, so find a slow target, line up the pass, and swing as you go by. The exact mechanics are not published yet, so the best setup is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a melee drive-by, and drive-bys can be attempted again at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash — the total is cumulative, so keep laundering as you earn. Which contacts do the laundering and what cut they take is not published yet, so the exact route is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a cumulative $250,000 laundered, and Marked Bills keep coming from robberies, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food and everything else counts toward the cumulative total. This builds up naturally as you play, especially once you start buying vehicles and gear. The exact shop list is not published yet, but any purchase in any shop counts, so just keep spending as you go.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for a cumulative $100,000 spent in shops, and shops stay open all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property — the starter list counts 8 garages, and the trophy pops when the last one is yours. Garages cost money, so save up and buy them as you can afford them; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for the Whip It Good trophy. The exact garage list and prices are not published yet, so the full set is to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks to purchase all garage properties, and properties stay for sale all game, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game app for your rides. Register each vehicle you want to keep, and the count builds up as your collection grows. How registration works in the app is not published yet, so the exact steps are to be confirmed at launch.
trophies.missable_reason: The description asks for 10 vehicles registered, and vehicles can be registered at any time, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: On the Spot
